result.instructions: Tools for Fourthwall, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many orders did we get this week, and which products sold most?"; "Which products are sold out right now?"; "Hide the product 'Spring hoodie' from the storefront until it is restocked.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fourthwall data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fourthwall_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fourthwall_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fourthwall_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fourthwall_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_shop
tools.title: Get shop
tools.description: Get the connected shop: id, name, domain, public domain and status (LIVE, COMING_SOON or PASSWORD_PROTECTED). Good first call. GET /shops/current.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_shop_contact_info
tools.title: Get shop contact info
tools.description: Get the shop's contact details as set in the shop settings. GET /shops/current/contact-info.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (offers) in the shop, with state (PUBLIC, HIDDEN, ARCHIVED...), availability and images. Optional text search. GET /products.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product (offer) by id: name, description, type, state, variants, images and digital files. GET /products/{productId}.

productId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_product_inventory
tools.title: Get product inventory
tools.description: Get the stock of each variant of one product (offer). GET /products/{productId}/inventory.

productId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_set_product_availability
tools.title: Set product availability
tools.description: Mark one product (offer) sold out (available=false) or available again (available=true). Shoppers see the change at once. PUT /products/{productId}/availability.

productId.description: The id from a list or get result.

available.description: true = available to buy, false = sold out.

tools.name: fourthwall_set_product_state
tools.title: Set product visibility
tools.description: Show one product on the storefront (PUBLIC) or unlist it (HIDDEN). Archiving is not offered here. PUT /products/{productId}/state.

productId.description: The id from a list or get result.

state.description: PUBLIC = visible on the storefront, HIDDEN = unlisted.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List the shop's collections (product groups) with their slugs and states. GET /collections.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_collection
tools.title: Get collection
tools.description: Get one collection by its id or its slug. GET /collections/{collectionIdOrSlug}.

collectionIdOrSlug.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_collection_products
tools.title: List collection products
tools.description: List the products in one collection, optionally only those with one status (PUBLIC, AVAILABLE, SOLD_OUT, HIDDEN, ARCHIVED). GET /collections/{collectionId}/products.

collectionId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_set_collection_availability
tools.title: Set collection availability
tools.description: Mark one collection available (true) or unavailable (false) on the storefront. PUT /collections/{collectionId}/availability.

collectionId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first in pages. Filter by buyer email, by created or updated time window, or by status (one or more). Contains customer names and addresses. GET /order.

status.description: Keep only orders in these statuses.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order by id: buyer, billing and shipping address, amounts, status and ordered offers. GET /order/{orderId}.

orderId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_order_by_friendly_id
tools.title: Get order by friendly id
tools.description: Get one order by its customer-facing friendly id (the number on the buyer's receipt). GET /order/by-friendly-id/{friendlyId}.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_promotions
tools.title: List promotions
tools.description: List discount promotions, optionally only those with the given codes. GET /promotions.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_promotion
tools.title: Get promotion
tools.description: Get one promotion by id: discount, limits, requirements and validity. GET /promotions/{promotionId}.

promotionId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_membership_tiers
tools.title: List membership tiers
tools.description: List the shop's membership tiers and their prices. GET /memberships/tiers.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the shop's paying members, in pages. Contains member names and emails. GET /memberships/members.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: Get one member by id: tier, subscription and dates. GET /memberships/members/{id}.

memberId.description: The numeric member id from fourthwall_list_members.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_donations
tools.title: List donations
tools.description: List donations received by the shop, in pages. GET /donations.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_donation
tools.title: Get donation
tools.description: Get one donation by id: amounts, message and donor fields as the shop received them. GET /donations/{donationId}.

donationId.description: The id from a list or get result.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_mailing_list_entries
tools.title: List mailing list entries
tools.description: List the shop's mailing list subscribers, in pages. Contains email addresses. GET /mailing-list-entries.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the shop: target URL and event types. GET /webhooks.

tools.name: fourthwall_list_webhook_events
tools.title: List webhook events
tools.description: List recent webhook events (for example ORDER_PLACED, DONATION), with their delivery state. Useful to check what the shop sent. GET /webhook-events.

type.description: Event types to keep, for example ORDER_PLACED.

tools.name: fourthwall_get_streaming_status
tools.title: Get streaming status
tools.description: Get whether the shop is currently marked as live streaming. GET /streaming.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Fourthwall
prompts.description: What you can do with Fourthwall here, with example requests to try.
